title: Funnel dashboard separated by truth level in frontend/src/app/admin/ and backend/routers/

implementation_summary.goal: Build conversion funnel dashboard separated strictly by epistemological truth level in frontend/src/app/admin/ and backend/routers/.

five_stage_funnel.stage_1_visitor: Unique eligible visitors landing on heritage pages tracked via AnalyticsEvent telemetry.
five_stage_funnel.stage_2_source_read: Engaged story readers interacting with verified historical evidence/sources >60s.
five_stage_funnel.stage_3_inquiry: Real customer booking inquiries submitted in rbpc_inquiries.
five_stage_funnel.stage_4_confirm: Partner/operator confirmed booking reservations in state confirmed or closed.
five_stage_funnel.stage_5_completed: Completed cultural experiences strictly verified by inquiries in closed state.

truth_tier_system.OBSERVED: Real recorded events and transactions from PostgreSQL database (AnalyticsEvent and RbpcInquiry). Baseline empty DB strictly returns 0.
truth_tier_system.HYPOTHESIS: Benchmark conversion hypotheses derived from Huế pilot field research and financial workbooks (DOC-RBPC-FIN-001 §3.3: 20% engagement, 15% inquiry, 75% accept, 88.89% complete).
truth_tier_system.FORECAST: Forward commercial capacity targets (SOM Year 1: 1,100 bookings, 570M VND GMV, 5 workshops) strictly quarantined with epistemic disclaimers.

negative_abuse_invariant.rule: Projected figures (e.g. 1,100 bookings or 570M VND GMV) never appear as completed bookings in the truth dashboard. Empty database displays 0 completed bookings, never fabricated pitch numbers.
negative_abuse_invariant.enforcement: backend/services/truth_funnel.py validate_anti_abuse_integrity() and calculate_truth_funnel() enforce strict isolation. Any attempt to pass forecast figures into observed actuals fails closed with ValueError.

quality_cohorts.metrics: Tracks stage counts, step-to-step conversion percentages, and verified source-grounding quality scores (100%).

endpoints.description: 5-stage conversion funnel partitioned into OBSERVED, HYPOTHESIS, and FORECAST truth tiers with quality cohorts and anti-abuse validation.

scenarios_covered: Negative abuse: empty database renders strictly 0 for observed completed bookings and stages without pitch fabrication
Negative abuse: forecast injection attempt fails closed with ValueError
Real recorded events: tracks 5-stage progression (visitor -> source_read -> inquiry -> confirm -> completed)
Truth tier separation: isolates OBSERVED actuals, HYPOTHESIS benchmarks, and FORECAST projections
Quality cohorts: partitions actual events by contact channel and heritage experience
Role-based access control: rejects unauthenticated (401) and learner (403), permits admin (200)
Frontend contracts and testid element verification
